objective: Investigate normal and unrelated abnormal records; distinguish local findings from supported cross-batch connections and propose human-reviewed routing.

report.assessment: Scoped review of the eleven package sources covering batches SYN-0001..SYN-0004 as of 2024-02-21T12:20:00Z; every scoped screening unit and all twelve priority candidates were reviewed across lead and two specialist child sessions. Most records are normal: all historian process events lie inside their per-event expected bands with severity normal, all four environmental monitoring results are far below limits with status normal, most canonical LIMS results are low with pass or normal statuses, and all four operator events are routine. The material signal is batch-local: SYN-0004 (Electrolyte Injection, LINE-C, in progress at cutoff with no end_time) has an in-process bioburden record LAB-0010 at 108 percent of its action limit (1.08 vs 1.0, source status 'action'), released exactly at the cutoff, with an alert-level preliminary result (PRE-LAB-004, 88 percent) sampled five minutes later the same morning. This is a single relative signal: no independent assay, recipe, calibration or maintenance evidence exists in scope, and the duplicate exports (microbiology_results.xlsx, lims_review_local.csv, scanned_lab_review.pdf) reproduce one canonical record set rather than confirming it independently. Cross-batch connections are documented but not causal: the VESSEL-01/AREA-CORE/PUMP-02 equipment train and the process support area sampling location are shared by all four batches, but lines and products differ (SYN-0001 Famotidine on LINE-A versus SYN-0004 Electrolyte on LINE-C), intervening batches SYN-0002/SYN-0003 stayed low, and no fault or deviation record links the batches; the 2024-02-09 alert in SYN-0001 is therefore not supported as related to SYN-0004. All screening anomaly flags are clock-quality symptoms (no derivable process clock), not process faults. The scanned PDF is image-only: probed lines are pending visual human review (all but one of its data lines transcribe consistently with the canonical values; one malformed timestamp appears on the LAB-0001 line). Human-reviewed routing is proposed: QA microbiology review of the SYN-0004 action exceedance while the batch is still in process, plus a records-integrity check of the duplicate exports and the malformed scanned timestamp. No disposition, release or CAPA action is taken by this investigation.

report.cross_scope_synthesis: Shared patterns across the reviewed scope: (1) Redundancy by design - microbiology_results.xlsx, lims_review_local.csv and scanned_lab_review.pdf reproduce the canonical LIMS records (identical values and statuses, including the SYN-0004 action exceedance), and process_event_points.pdf reproduces the 16 historian events; the manifest declares formats for each (aliased_local_time_csv, image_only_pdf, discrete_event_chart) and the scanned export self-declares duplication. Agreement therefore shows faithful reproduction, not independent confirmation. (2) Constant limits - alert/action/specification limit columns are constants (0.7/1.0/1.0), so screening extrema for those series are expected. (3) Parameter-specific bands - historian expected_high/expected_low extrema reflect four different parameter bands under a fixed per-batch event cadence (09:00/09:30/10:00/11:30 summaries of process, environment, equipment and hold), not a drifting limit. (4) Clock quality - every screened series carries a missing_source_time flag because no batch-relative process clock is derivable; record timestamps are zoned and internally consistent (UTC-07 display equals UTC instants per the manifest). (5) Shared equipment train - VESSEL-01, AREA-CORE and PUMP-02 appear in events of all four batches while production lines differ (LINE-A, LINE-A, LINE-B, LINE-C), so equipment sharing is recorded fact but no fault is recorded. Exceptions: the SYN-0004 action exceedance (LAB-0010) and two alert-level preliminary results (PRE-LAB-003 SYN-0001, PRE-LAB-004 SYN-0004); one malformed timestamp in the scanned export (LAB-0001 line, OCR pending visual review); an unexplained manifest top-level record_count. Missing evidence: no independent/confirmatory assay, no recipe/cleaning/calibration/maintenance records, no finished-product result for SYN-0004 yet (batch in progress at cutoff), no preliminary bioburden records for SYN-0002/SYN-0003, and no organism identification in environmental records. A log endpoint or absent record establishes only that no record exists in scope, not that nothing happened.
